open_points.subject: change_staff_status / authenticate_staff
open_points.text: the recorded value is a record only and decides no sign-in, which depends on the active status alone.
open_points.other_text: authenticate_staff: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST normalize email, accept only an account whose status is StaffStatus.ACTIVE with a password verify_password matches, deciding nothing on email_verified_at, issue a hashed fixed-expiry session, audit success or concealed failure, and never reveal which check failed: every rejection raises what conceal_authentication_failure returns.
open_points.question: Must sign-in depend on active status alone, or on both active status and a matching password; alternatively, should the first passage say that email_verified_at alone does not affect sign-in?
